openQuestions: US-R1-002 (WARNING, scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts:138) is still pending on this same PRD: the skip-ratchet gate is fail-open on a crashed/zero-test/garbage `bun test` run (makeDefaultGetSuiteOutput discards exit code/success, parseSkipCount defaults missing lines to 0). nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 removed the no-flaky-evasion doctrine carve-out that a prior US-002 patterns.md bullet (previously at line 1088, CRITICAL review round-1 finding) had committed into durable project doctrine: that bullet narrated a failure observed inside a literal PRD oracle run (US-002 AC4's env -i restricted-PATH bun test) and generalized dismissing it as a 'resource-contention artifact' into a rule future workers could cite. Fix applied: (1) truncated the original US-002 bullet to stop right after the PATH-surgery reproduction recipe, removing the carve-out sentence entirely; (2) appended a new correction bullet directly after it (same file, scripts/cam/patterns.md) explaining why the self-exemption did not hold (a failing test inside a story-relevant oracle run is a failing story oracle regardless of failure-mode characterization -- timing, subprocess, resource-contention -- no-flaky-evasion has no carve-out by label); (3) filed the underlying observed non-determinism in test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (five sequential waitForCondition polls bounded inside a single 45s outer test timeout, real subprocess SIGTERM/respawn timing) as its own follow-up issue, CAM-446, via the deterministic `cam issue --file-local` CLI path (JSON payload piped to stdin; committed straight to main, verified: `chore(cam): file CAM-446` at 99035ba). No production code was touched by this story -- pure patterns.md doctrine edit plus an out-of-band issue filing. Full quality spine re-run clean after the edit: bun run typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5720 pass / 0 fail / 12916 expect() across 341 files, bun run check:all all 16 gates green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet: host lane 0 skip matches expectation). scripts/cam/prd.json's working-tree diff (adding the US-R1-001/US-R1-002 round-1-fix stories plus the review block) was left uncommitted by this story per the established convention (verified against precedent commits 43a0e1f6/13c24b2c): prd.json is supervisor-owned and gets its own separate 'chore(cam): finalize' commit after the supervisor reads worker-report.json, never bundled into a feat: commit. US-R1-002 (the WARNING finding on scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts's fail-open suite-crash blind spot) is the next pending round-1-fix story on this PRD and was not touched here.
